Q4 Project Awards.department: Global E-Commerce-Global Selling Full Service-Business Middle Platform-3P Supply Chain Ops
Q4 Project Awards.reason:
Background: In 2025 BF, various changes and challenges existed in tariffs and policies across countries. Full-chain fulfillment time met: Through chartered plane first-leg time control, handover link optimization, and card-shift scheduling control, achieved all countries full-chain time on target during campaign.
Campaign stocking & inventory both exceeded expectations: Full-cycle daily average out-of-stock rate below 1%. Full-cycle daily average turnover improved 7 days vs same period last year.
A-segment in/outbound and B-segment all-dimension plans met operational targets, supporting A/B-segment smooth fulfillment. A-segment in/outbound accuracy both met target and improved vs 2024. B-segment total net weight/split cargo type net weight weighted W+1 accuracy was continuously corrected based on target, and final accuracy all met target.

Q4 Project Awards.project_name: Product Listing Agent Project
Q4 Project Awards.department: Global E-Commerce-Global Selling Full Service-Business Middle Platform-Product Information Operations
Q4 Project Awards.reason:
Product Listing Agent aims to improve efficiency and output of product listing operations staff. Listing operations staff daily need to complete large amounts of product listing work including multi-country image-to-text translation, title optimization, image optimization, and description optimization across many countries. For example, manual title SEO optimization output is 33,000/month, and manual image optimization output is 18,000/month. Relying purely on manual work can no longer meet business scale growth needs, becoming a key bottleneck to break through.
Product Listing Agent project took this business pain point as entry point, built listing online capability (product selection -> content generation -> AB testing -> full rollout or rollback -> effect evaluation). Currently, 100% of core listing work scenarios are online. Additionally, focusing on title optimization scenario, the project team deeply understood SEO optimization operation process, achieved SEO optimization online -> automation through technical means, bringing massive improvement in product optimization scale and amplifying business benefits. Product optimization scale grew from 33,000/month (June) -> 350,000/month (September) -> 3,840,000/month (December) (116x efficiency improvement vs manual). December non-unsold product (best-seller, hot-seller, normal seller, cold-start) exposure PV increased 6%+, daily average exposure increment 940,000, daily average GMV increment $30,000.
